summary: Surveyed all 44 changed files by size and by a per-file count of Lean declaration keywords (theorem/lemma/def/structure/class/instance/inductive/abbrev/example/axiom/opaque). 42 files carry declarations: the Sparkle HDL core (Signal, IR, Optimize, Elab, backends for Verilog/C/CUDA/SMT, Verification/Cost), the SVParser tool chain (Lexer, Parser, Lower, Verify, VerifyEmit, DslEmit), and tests and verification demos that state circuits and roundtrip checks. They stay searchable. Sparkle.lean holds only imports and a comment; it stays primary-eligible under FILTER-007. Tests/SymbolicParameterEmit.lean holds imports plus four #synthesizeParameterizedVerilog commands; those are executable formal commands, so it stays. Only lakefile.lean is excluded: I read all 1217 lines, and it is Lake build configuration with no formal mathematics. The other file of the earlier exclusion, Examples/FPU/old/lakefile.lean, is not in this change set.
